en.headline: Police officer charged with misconduct over indecent messages to suspect’s friend
en.dek: A 32-year-old officer from Kwai Tsing district is accused of privately contacting a female friend of a man arrested in a 2025 criminal case and sending her indecent texts and photos; he appears in court on Friday.
body: New Territories South Regional Crime Unit officers arrested a 32-year-old man in Tuen Mun on 20 August on suspicion of misconduct in public office. The man is a police officer attached to Kwai Tsing district and has been suspended from duty.

Investigators said that while handling a criminal case that occurred in May 2025, the officer allegedly contacted a female friend of the arrested person without authority and sent her indecent messages and photographs. The woman reported the matter to police on 12 May 2025.
He has been charged with one count of misconduct in public office. The case will be mentioned at Sha Tin Magistrates’ Courts on the morning of 28 August.
Police said the force attaches great importance to the integrity of its officers and will not tolerate any illegal conduct.

zh.headline: 男警涉向疑犯女友人傳不雅短訊及照片 被控公職人員行為失當
zh.dek: 32歲葵青警區男警被指在調查2025年刑事案件期間私下聯絡被捕人的女性朋友並傳送不雅內容，明日於沙田裁判法院提堂，已被停職。
body: 新界南總區重案組人員於8月20日在屯門區拘捕一名32歲男子，涉嫌公職人員行為失當。警方指被捕男子為一名警務人員，隸屬葵青警區，現已被停職。
調查顯示，他在調查一宗發生於2025年5月的刑事案件期間，涉嫌私下聯絡該案被捕人的女性朋友，並向其傳送不雅短訊及照片。該名女子於2025年5月12日向警方報案。
經調查後，該名男子已被控一項公職人員行為失當罪，案件將於明日（8月28日）上午在沙田裁判法院提堂。
警方表示非常重視人員的操守，任何人員干犯違法行為，警隊絕不容忍和姑息，必定嚴正處理。
